children.game_version: A game where children practice the 'gathering' motion to collect toy rice or props.

seniors.seated_version: Focus on the hand and arm gestures of the rice-gathering motion while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the hand gestures while standing in place, omitting complex formations.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to ensure comfort and stability.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Dominant hand movements mimicking the gathering of rice.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers form a formation with the tandok in the middle.

signature_moves.description: Hand movements that illustrate the atmosphere of gathering rice into a container.
signature_moves.name: Rice gathering gesture

signature_moves.description: Movements derived from the traditional Tor Tor dance performed during celebrations.
signature_moves.name: Tor Tor movement

music_profile.sound_description: The music is an ensemble performance featuring the Sarune and Taganing, similar to Javanese gamelan, with variations driven by the instrumentalists.

basic_steps: Hand movements mimicking the gathering of rice into a container
Formation changes with the tandok placed in the center
teaching.formation: Usually four dancers, but can be any even number
